claims.claim: Photius of Constantinople was the Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople from 858 to 867 and from 877 to 886.
Photius was born circa 815 and died on 6 February 893.
Photius is recognized in the Eastern Orthodox Church as 'Saint Photius the Great'.
Photius was appointed patriarch in 858 while still a layman, quickly ordained and elevated to the office.
Photius wrote numerous scriptural works including questions and answers on points in Scripture.
